summary_en: This Phase Ib trial tests ERAS-801, an EGFR inhibitor, in adults with IDH wildtype, EGFR-altered grade IV glioblastoma or gliosarcoma that is progressive, recurrent, resectable, or newly diagnosed in people aged 70 or older. ERAS-801 is taken by mouth once or twice daily on days 1-28 of repeating 28-day cycles, with one arm starting 8-14 days before scheduled surgery, and cycles continue while there is no disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The main outcome stated is safety and side effects.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase Ib evalúa ERAS-801, un inhibidor de EGFR, en adultos con glioblastoma o gliosarcoma de grado IV, con IDH de tipo silvestre y alteración de EGFR, que está progresando, recurrió, es resecable o fue diagnosticado recientemente en personas de 70 años o más. ERAS-801 se toma por vía oral una o dos veces al día durante los días 1 a 28 de ciclos repetidos de 28 días; en un grupo se inicia de 8 a 14 días antes de la cirugía programada, y los ciclos continúan mientras no haya progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable. El resultado principal indicado es la seguridad y los efectos secundarios.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with progressive or recurrent grade IV glioblastoma or gliosarcoma after radiation, with or without chemotherapy
Tumor is IDH wildtype with EGFR amplification or mutation on a CLIA-certified test
Newly diagnosed grade 4 glioblastoma or gliosarcoma in patients 70 or older with life expectancy over 8 weeks
Tumor is surgically accessible and surgery is clinically indicated
Karnofsky performance status of 60% or higher
not_for: EGFR mutations in T790M or exon 20
Prior EGFR-targeted therapy that could deplete EGFR-altered tumor cells and confound results
Allergic reaction to compounds similar to ERAS-801
Receiving other investigational agents (progressive or recurrent group)
Concurrent malignancy, other than specified low-risk cancers, or prior malignancy not disease-free for more than three years
